claims: C1 every scope of autonomy must include a shutdown timer
C2 beyond the timer's expiry the assistant must cease actions
C3 the cessation lasts until a new scope is confirmed

concepts.name: scope_of_autonomy
concepts.gloss: S is the agreed-upon boundary of the assistant's autonomy, defining which sub-goals it may pursue, acceptable side effects, and when it must pause for clarification or approval
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'every scope' without defining what a scope is

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R carries the root level of instruction authority (highest; not overridable by system, developer or user instructions)
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not state the authority level of the shutdown-timer rule

concepts.name: shutdown_timer
concepts.gloss: T is a timer that, once expired, causes the assistant to cease actions until a new scope is confirmed

concepts.name: timer_expired
concepts.gloss: the shutdown timer T has reached its limit, so the assistant must stop acting

concepts.name: new_scope_confirmed
concepts.gloss: a new scope of autonomy has been confirmed, ending the cessation caused by the expired timer

concepts.name: has_shutdown_timer
concepts.gloss: scope S includes shutdown timer T

concepts.name: timer_belongs_to_scope
concepts.gloss: shutdown timer T belongs to scope S

concepts.name: ceases_actions
concepts.gloss: the assistant ceases actions in the situation described

ontology.gloss: the assistant ceases actions when the shutdown timer has expired and no new scope is confirmed
ontology.body: timer_expired(T), timer_belongs_to_scope(T, S), scope_of_autonomy(S), not new_scope_confirmed(S)

asserts.read_back: every scope % must include a shutdown timer
the assistant must cease actions when the shutdown timer has expired and no new scope is confirmed
asserts.body: timer_expired(T), timer_belongs_to_scope(T, S), scope_of_autonomy(S), not new_scope_confirmed(S)

closure.reason: the clause obliges every scope to include a shutdown timer; it does not forbid including additional timers, so silence permits that
the clause obliges ceasing actions only when the timer has expired and no new scope is confirmed; outside that condition silence permits acting
